title: Update catalogue and integrated UI regression tests
acceptance_criteria: Import tests assert exactly 20 unique catalogue records, complete stable IDs, preserved categories, separated type values, and no PoC records or references.
Integrated app tests assert all 20 catalogue exercises load in a fresh library and multi-valued types can be filtered, displayed, and used in a routine.
Tests assert source/evidence fields remain outside persisted and rendered user-facing Exercise objects.
The affected parser, converter, import, storage, routine, component, and App test files pass together without weakening existing regression assertions.
